# Florida Keys Food Tours (concept by Kerblabs)

> Food tours, a cooking class and sunset cruise in Islamorada and Key Largo, Florida. This is an unaffiliated concept page; facts come from flkeysfoodtour.com.

- Phone: (305) 394-1028
- Email: flkeysfoodtour@gmail.com
- Booking: most tours via FareHarbor; Key Largo Food Tour by phone
- Hours: not published

## Tours (from-prices, per their site)
- The Original Islamorada Food Tour: $119, 4 hours, up to 12, all ages
- Florida Keys Fish Cooking Class: $99, 1.5 hours, up to 20, all ages
- Islamorada Golf Cart Food Tour: $179, 4 hours, up to 10, all ages
- Islamorada Golf Cart Evening Sunset Food Tour: $199, 3 hours, up to 10, 21+
- Islamorada Local's Happy Hour Tour: $99, 2 hours, up to 8, 21+
- Islamorada Sunset Happy Hour Tour: $129, 3 hours, up to 8
- Holiday Shopping Luxury Golf Cart Food Tour: $149, 3 hours, up to 10
- Islamorada Sunset Boat Cruise Food Tour: $1,400, 3 hours, up to 6
- Key Largo Food Tour: $109, 4 hours, up to 12, phone booking

## FAQ
- Where? Islamorada and Key Largo, Florida.
- How to book? FareHarbor online, or call (305) 394-1028 for Key Largo.
